rationale: Reduces the white inner fill of switched-off LED strips to 70% opacity. The fully opaque off fill exists in stable v1.82.0; on/unavailable appearance and outline are preserved.

summary.ru: Внутренняя заливка выключенных LED-лент имеет прозрачность 30%; включённый вид и обводка сохранены.
summary.en: The inner fill of switched-off LED strips is 30% transparent; lit appearance and outlines are preserved.
